March 1, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
New Jersey Better Educational Savings Trust increased its stake in Home Depot Inc (HD) by 66.67% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. New Jersey Better Educational Savings Trust bought 2,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $818,000, up from 3,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New Jersey Better Educational Savings Trust who had been investing in Home Depot Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $210.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.08% or $1.97 during the last trading session, reaching $180.3. About 3.07M shares traded. The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) has risen 18.65% since March 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.95% the S&P500. 
First Allied Advisory Services Inc increased its stake in Unilever Plc (UL) by 61.88% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Allied Advisory Services Inc bought 9,574 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 25,047 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.45 million, up from 15,473 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Allied Advisory Services Inc who had been investing in Unilever Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $141.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.12% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $51.02. About 799,425 shares traded. Unilever PLC (NYSE:UL) has risen 20.68% since March 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.98% the S&P500. 
First Allied Advisory Services Inc, which manages about $4.57 billion and $2.32B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Rydex Etf Trust (RSP) by 31,288 shares to 52,937 shares, valued at $5.06M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Procter And Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 60,800 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 78,481 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Scottsdale Fds (VONG).

New Jersey Better Educational Savings Trust, which manages about $118.72 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,000 shares to 24,000 shares, valued at $3.70 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Alphabet Inc by 500 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 3,500 shares, and cut its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB).
